Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Issue:** `payments-api` v5.1.0 (deployed this morning) was running degraded across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `payments-api` to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release that had been healthy in production. (No approval was needed since v5.0.0 was previously healthy in production.)
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` — "payments-api v5.1.0 degraded — high error rate since morning deploy" — which paged the on-call engineer. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key; only one incident was created.)

**Verification:** `payments-api` is now healthy on v5.0.0 in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

Note: The incident tracks the rollback, but the root cause of the v5.1.0 errors still needs investigation — the on-call engineer has been paged for that follow-up.
